criteria.requirement: A furnished open-sided 6-by-4-meter 3D room starts with sofa, coffee table, armchair and floor lamp plus an adding palette.
criteria.action: Inspect the initial room, its dimensions and furniture palette.
criteria.expected: A 6-by-4-meter open-sided room contains sofa, coffee table, armchair and floor lamp with an adding palette.

criteria.requirement: Selection highlights furniture and supports rotate-by-90, color changes, deletion and adding more instances.
criteria.action: Select, add, rotate by 90 degrees, recolor and delete instances of the specified furniture.
criteria.expected: Selection highlights the intended object and each edit changes that furniture consistently.

criteria.requirement: Dragging moves furniture on the floor, optional snapping works and camera rotation is disabled during drag.
criteria.action: Drag furniture with snapping off and on while attempting a camera drag.
criteria.expected: Furniture moves on the floor, optional snapping works and the camera does not rotate during furniture dragging.

criteria.requirement: The specified placeable furniture stays within room bounds and does not overlap other placeable furniture; invalid moves/rotations visibly warn and preserve the last valid placement. Do not extend this assertion to decorative plants without a task-defined placement role.
criteria.action: Move and rotate specified furniture against room bounds and other placeable furniture.
criteria.expected: Furniture footprints stay inside the room and do not overlap; invalid edits visibly warn and retain the last valid placement. Decorative plants are not automatically part of this required furniture-collision boundary.

criteria.requirement: Perspective/orbit and top-down views preserve the same arrangement and selection.
criteria.action: Switch between orbitable perspective and top-down views after editing/selecting furniture.
criteria.expected: The arrangement and selection stay unchanged across views.

criteria.requirement: Save/restore persist the arrangement in local storage; reset recovers the initial room.
criteria.action: Save the arrangement, change it, restore it after reload and reset.
criteria.expected: Browser-local save/restore recovers the saved arrangement and reset recovers the initial layout; storage technology requires evidence if not browser-observable.

criteria.requirement: The palette and editing controls are comfortable to use on narrow touch layouts.
criteria.action: Use the palette and furniture edits in a narrow touch viewport.
criteria.expected: Adding, selecting and editing furniture remain reachable and comfortable with touch.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the room dimensions and initial furniture/palette.
Add/select/edit an item, move it on the floor and switch between perspective and plan views.
Try an overlapping or outside placement and an invalid rotation, then save/reload/restore and reset while comparing visible states.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
